reason: Provides session-isolated file uploads and a document-reading tool for text, PDF, DOCX, and XLSX content, with web UI integration and bounded parsing features.

summaries.zh: 通过会话隔离的文件上传界面和 read_document 工具，帮助模型读取文本、PDF、DOCX 与 XLSX 文档。
summaries.en: Provides session-isolated file uploads and a read_document tool for helping models read text, PDF, DOCX, and XLSX documents.

capabilities: Uploads files through a web interface
Stores uploaded files in session-isolated workspace directories
Reads and parses text, PDF, DOCX, and XLSX files
Provides paginated document content through a read_document tool
Caches parsed document contents in memory
